newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T at June highs on insurance talk.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T at June highs on insurance talk.

text.p: Shares in tobacco and insurance conglomerate B.A.T Industries Plc rose on Tuesday amid continued demerger speculation and talk of further bids and mergers in the insurance sector, dealers and analysts said.
The stock was up 9-1/2p at 524 by 1241 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 526p -- its highest since last June.
"People still seem to be excited about life assets," said an analyst at one leading brokerage, "B.A.T. has lagged companies that have come up in the wake of the Scottish Amicable excitement."
B.A.T owns UK insurer Eagle Star.

Insurance stocks have leapt higher in recent sessions as bids from Prudential Corp Plc and Abbey National Plc for mutually-owned Scottish Amicable sparked talk of further bid activity in the industry.
"We still think that the stock is cheap," the analyst said. "The risk of U.S. litigation in tobacco was overdone."
